verdicts.reason: Both share the same structural flaws. The centred SOLSTICE wordmark sits above a left-aligned headline. 'back' is orphaned on its own line. There is a dead band between the headline and the phone. Both badges have been pushed below the CTA, which breaks the original reading order. A keeps the badges as a tight pair and the brand close to the headline, but its tagline floats alone in the gap between the phone and the CTA. B groups the tagline with the CTA better, but leaves SOLSTICE stranded far above the headline and spreads the two badges apart with a large gap, so the bottom reads as scattered fragments.
